# Integration

Curated t-shirt design storefront blending Japanese streetwear with modern aesthetics — "Different Styles, One Identity." Browse the catalog, view product details, and manage cart, checkout (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Cash on Delivery), account, and orders online.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/): Hero banners, featured products, seasonal collections
- [Shop](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/shop): Full catalog with search, filters, sort, and pagination
- [Cart](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/cart): Shopping cart management
- [Checkout](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/checkout): Address, shipping, and payment method selection (login required)
- [My Orders](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/orders): Order history
- [Log in](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/login): Account sign in
- [Sign up](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/signup): Create an account

## Company

- [About](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/about): Brand story
- [Contact](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/contact): Contact information
- [FAQ](https://integration-06n2.onrender.com/faq): Frequently asked questions
